podcasts.title: Hard Fork — October 2, 2026 episode
podcasts.summary: The episode examines AI personal assistants alongside recent agent failures and the privacy trade-offs that follow when software can act across user data and services.

podcasts.connection_to_brief: It directly complements the brief’s ambient-agent and governed web-search stories by supplying the user-facing failure and privacy perspective behind those architecture choices.
